name: model-ladder
what: Each subagent call must name a model, and the model has to fit the job: expensive models only for listed jobs, cheap ones never for reviews, and nothing above cheap for plain lookups.

faults.fault: The expensive-model job check is switched off, so any job can use the expensive tier.
Build words no longer rescue a description from the lookup rule, so "find every caller and fix them" is refused.
The end-of-word boundary is dropped, so "listen" counts as the lookup word "list".
Lookup words count anywhere in the description again, so a noun such as "folder list" sends a build job to the cheap model.
Read-only agent types are no longer excused, so a scout that names a review in passing is refused a cheap model.
